entries.title: Fixed Twin Mirror Shutter Signal Stand
entries.description: One original complete fixed non-weapon camp optical-signal-stand exterior: grounded three-foot splayed tripod and spreaders, one transverse instrument beam, two separate U-fork mirror supports with full round opaque metal discs/rims and transverse axle/thumbwheel exteriors, and a complete open shutter frame held in front of the larger disc by two finite forward brackets. Four fixed tilted shutter leaves and full thin axles preserve actual openings. The smaller entire fork/mirror is held at a different fixed yaw on the same beam; no optical alignment is implied. Not an imported shop wall mirror or a surveying telescope with its barrel removed: full new common-frame geometry, secondary mirror and shutter mounting relationship. Three opaque PBR materials, metres and XY-centred ground soles, one model and zero scenes. Static display only, no usable optics, signalling procedure, targeting, transmission, mirror tracking, reflection accuracy, motion, load or safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Upper Cup and Ring Nozzle Hand Sprayer
entries.description: One newly authored complete fixed upper-cup paint-sprayer-style professional appearance. A tall capped tapered reservoir stands on a short neck above one compact horizontal body. The front has a genuine annular cap mouth, a recessed central blunt nozzle appearance and two short opposed cap horns. One whole canted hand grip with a flat display heel carries a separate long curved trigger, leaving a real visible finger gap; two rear adjustment exteriors and a short low inlet fitting complete the device. The capped cup is an exterior solid shell appearance, not a claimed accessible fluid reservoir; the front recess is finite, not a proven continuous operating passage. All numeric geometry new, not the glue applicator with its stick removed or a hairdryer with an added bottle. One prop zero scenes and three opaque materials. Static game art only: no fluid, coating, spray pattern, pressure system, chemical use, operating instructions, adjustment, manufacture, protective effectiveness or equipment safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Right Angle Nose and Open Handle Hand Riveter
entries.description: One newly authored complete static compact hand-riveter-style exterior. A continuous long fixed handle and raised head-support body carries a short transverse round head with a genuinely open annular nose. A second whole long squeeze handle is held in one splayed pose about a fixed broad pivot, leaving a complete visible grip gap. Two separate full hand pads, finite pivot end retainers and a closed rear head plug complete the object. The nose mouth is a finite visual recess, not a claimed continuous operating passage. All numeric shapes newly authored, not crossed serrated pliers with their tips replaced or a hand tacker with its magazine removed. One prop zero scenes and three opaque materials. Fixed visual game art only: no rivet, workpiece, motion, actual pulling mechanism, force, manufacture, instructions, ergonomics or tool safety claim.

entries.title: Fixed Continuous Spatial Loop Bead Route
entries.description: One newly authored complete static tabletop wire-and-bead toy. A single closed solid wire starts inside one base collar, follows a low straight loading run, travels through an entire pitched vertical loop, crosses a low bridge, passes through a second vertical loop in a perpendicular plane and returns into the second base collar. Five whole thick barrel-shaped beads have genuine polygonal through-bores on actual straight portions of that same route. Each bead has a small explicit eccentric offset giving matching wire/bore facet contact, rather than a floating ring. One full finite wooden base supports both terminal roots. Unlike the existing upright abacus, there are no five separate parallel straight shafts or two tall end stiles; unlike the gimballed board maze, there is no floor route, wall labyrinth or tilting tray. All whole geometry independently authored, not a bent copy of an old rod or changed bead-count asset. Three opaque constant untextured PBR roles, metres, Z up and whole horizontally bounds-centred ground origin. One whole prop, zero scenes; beads and loops are not separate assets. Static illustrative pose only: no runtime slider, traversal of curves, solved motion or collision-free travel, educational outcome, child fit, choking/material suitability, load, manufacture or toy-safety claim.
